theater: 日惹、梭羅與中爪哇山區

battle.name: 爪哇戰爭
battle.theater: 日惹、梭羅與中爪哇山區
battle.brief: 一八二五年七月二十一日，日惹蘇丹長子迪波內加羅在塞拉隆洞穴宣布起兵，圍困日惹；總督德·科克八月解圍，九月率七千五百人入城，一八二六年十月十五日在梭羅以西的加沃克擊潰起義主力，戰事轉入游擊。卡面那件一五〇〇年的輪發手槍此時已被燧發手槍取代，只留同源的後膛機件給軍官與近衛佩用。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 這場衝突在荷屬東印度境內展開，交戰的兩方是一個歐洲殖民政府與一支以爪哇王族為首的起義軍，中間還夾著幾個立場分裂的爪哇王國。荷方的最高指揮是專員亨德里克·梅庫斯·德·科克，他在一八二五年七月二十六日被任命為諸王國專員，同時握有軍事與民政的權柄；部隊由巴達維亞總督府、三寶壟與泗水等地的聯隊提供，歐洲籍部隊多為拿破崙戰爭的退伍兵與來自德語區的移民，另有自荷蘭本土渡海增援的遠征軍；地方輔助兵則來自爪哇與馬都拉的民兵、孟古內加蘭團、北蘇拉威西與哥倫打洛的徵召兵、布通與馬魯古的徵召兵，以及巴厘王國派來的一千名傭兵，而荷方始終懷疑這些本地部隊的忠誠。盟邦方面，日惹蘇丹國由攝政會議與帕庫阿蘭的帕庫阿蘭一世站在荷方，但蘇丹家族中也有相當數目的成員倒向起義軍；梭羅蘇南國的帕庫布沃諾六世立場模糊，宮廷分成親荷與親叛兩派；孟古內加蘭的孟古內加羅二世明確親荷，其軍團曾獨立進剿起義軍，並因此獲頒威廉軍事勳章。起義軍一方，迪波內加羅模仿奧斯曼禁衛軍的體例，劃出十六名貴族出身的指揮官，各領兵千與封戶萬戶，另有六支王室近衛，他本人帶三百至四百騎兵的貼身衛隊與同樣數目的武裝僧人，實戰指揮則落在森托特·普拉維羅迪爾約手上，精神上的樞紐是凱亞·馬加，其叔父查亞庫蘇馬王公亦在軍中。爪哇各地另有星火：北岸森加望一帶，塞朗王公與其母阿根·塞朗夫人拉起一支號稱八千人的騎步混合部隊；東爪哇拉曼岸有拉登·阿里亞·薩斯拉迪拉加，恩加維與馬迪翁一帶有拉登·阿尤·尤達庫蘇馬。爪哇的華人聚落同時被起義軍視作異教掠奪者而遭攻擊，又被荷方懷疑向起義軍走私火器，而華商其實也在供應軍火與資金。
countriesEn: The conflict was fought inside the Dutch East Indies, between a European colonial government on one side and an insurgent army led by a Javanese prince on the other, with several Javanese principalities of divided loyalty caught in between. The Dutch command was headed by Hendrik Merkus de Kock, who on 26 July 1825 was appointed commissioner to the princely states and held military and civil authority at the same time. The troops came from the residencies at Batavia, Semarang and Surabaya; the European battalions were largely veterans of the Napoleonic Wars and recruits from German-speaking lands, with a further expeditionary force sent across the sea from the Netherlands itself. The native auxiliaries were drawn from Javanese and Madurese levies, the Mangkunegaran Legion, recruits from North Sulawesi and Gorontalo, from Buton and the Moluccas, together with a thousand Balinese mercenaries, and the Dutch never entirely trusted the loyalty of these local troops. On the allied side, the Yogyakarta Sultanate stood with the Dutch through its regency council and Paku Alam I of Pakualaman, though a fair number of the sultan's own relatives went over to the insurgents; Sunan Pakubuwono VI of the Surakarta Sunanate was ambiguous, his court splitting between the Dutch and the rebels; and Mangkunegara II of Mangkunegaran was openly pro-Dutch, his legion campaigning independently against the rebels and earning the Military Order of William for it. On the rebel side, Diponegoro organised his following on the model of the Ottoman janissaries, dividing his force among sixteen commanders of noble birth, each with a nominal thousand men and ten thousand households, and adding six units of royal guard; he himself kept a personal bodyguard of three to four hundred cavalry and a similar number of armed men of the priesthood, while battlefield command in fact fell to Sentot Prawirodirdjo, the spiritual hinge of the movement being Kyai Maja, and his uncle Prince Jayakusuma also served in the army. Sparks flew across Java besides: on the north coast around Semarang, Prince Serang and his mother Nyi Ageng Serang raised a mixed force of cavalry and infantry said to number eight thousand; in East Java at Rembang operated Raden Aria Sasradilaga, and around Ngawi and Madiun, Raden Ayu Yudakusuma. The Chinese communities of Java were at once attacked by the insurgents as foreign unbelievers, suspected by the Dutch of smuggling arms to them, and were themselves suppliers of arms and money to the insurgents.
people: 戰爭的主角是日惹蘇丹哈孟庫布沃諾三世的長子迪波內加羅，一七八五年生。他一八〇五年到爪哇南岸朝聖，後來自稱在海岸受到卡利查加聖人與羅羅基杜爾女神的示警，預見日惹將毀；英軍一八一二年攻破日惹王宮前，荷方本想把王位繼承權給他，他推辭了。他的父親一八一四年去世後，他以攝政身份輔佐年幼的蘇丹哈孟庫布沃諾五世，但與其他攝政的關係惡劣。一八二三年荷方派駐日惹的駐官斯米薩特向本地貴族索取重額賠償，並指定由迪波內加羅出面談判，談判破裂，他自此不再介入，一八二四年更被其他攝政排擠出宮廷。近因極為具體：一八二五年六月十七日，斯米薩特下令修築一條穿過迪波內加羅在德加爾雷亞莊園附近的道路，與莊園衛士衝突數次；七月二十日荷軍前來逮捕他，他退入塞拉隆洞穴，二十一日宣布起義。起義之後，實際的戰場指揮由森托特·普拉維羅迪爾約承擔，他是早年起事者朗加·普拉維拉迪爾加之子；精神上的樞紐是凱亞·馬加，一八二八年十一月遭伏擊後投降。荷方的代表是專員德·科克，他解日惹之圍、在加沃克擊敗起義軍，並以旺代戰爭相比擬起義軍的游擊戰法；一八三〇年三月他在馬格朗以談判為名把迪波內加羅拿下，又為他爭取到安全的通行待遇。上級方面，一八二四年上任的萊昂納德·杜·布斯為節制開支而限制徵兵，一八二八年接任的約翰內斯·范登博斯則奉國王威廉一世明確指示，必須殺死或擒獲迪波內加羅，不許議和。起義軍中的女性角色同樣關鍵：塞朗王公的母親阿根·塞朗夫人率領騎兵隊參戰，荷方稱尤達庫蘇馬為聰明而極其可怖的女人，她在一八二五年九月率部攻擊恩加維的華人聚落。
peopleEn: The central figure was Prince Diponegoro, eldest son of Sultan Hamengkubuwono III of Yogyakarta, born in 1785. In 1805 he made a pilgrimage to the south coast of Java and later wrote that there he received visions from Sunan Kalijaga and Nyai Roro Kidul and was warned of the ruin of Java; before the British storming of the keraton in 1812 the Dutch had meant to make him crown prince, and he refused it. After his father died in 1814 he acted as regent for the young Sultan Hamengkubuwono V, but his relations with the other regents were bad. In 1823 the Dutch resident at Yogyakarta, Smissaert, demanded heavy indemnities from the local aristocracy and nominated Diponegoro to negotiate them; the negotiation broke down, he refused to be involved again, and in 1824 the other regents pushed his allies out of the court. The immediate spark was very concrete: on 17 June 1825 Smissaert ordered a road built or repaired close to Diponegoro's Tegalreja estate, and it clashed several times with the men of the estate; on 20 July Dutch troops came to arrest him, he withdrew into the cave at Selarong, and on 21 July he declared his rebellion. After the rising began, actual command in the field was held by Sentot Prawirodirdjo, son of the earlier rebel Rongga Prawiradirja, while the spiritual pivot was Kyai Maja, ambushed and taken in November 1828. The Dutch representative was the commissioner de Kock, who relieved Yogyakarta, beat the insurgents at Gawok, and compared Diponegoro's guerrilla campaign to the war in the Vendée; in March 1830 he took Diponegoro at Magelang under the guise of a negotiation and obtained for him a safe conduct. Above him, Leonard du Bus, Governor-General from 1824, cut expenditure and so limited recruitment, and Johannes van den Bosch, who took over in 1828, carried explicit instructions from King William I that Diponegoro was to be killed or captured and that no agreement was to be entered into. Women played a key part on the rebel side as well: Nyi Ageng Serang, mother of Prince Serang, led a cavalry unit in the fighting, and the Dutch described Yudakusuma as a clever but much dreaded woman; in September 1825 she led an attack on the Chinese community at Ngawi.
kits: 卡面這件一五〇〇年的輪發手槍，是最早把擊砧機件裝上後膛的手槍：擊錘夾住黃鐵礦，扳機放開發條，鋼輪旋轉，摩擦飛出的火星落入火藥盤，火鑼上的一小塊黃鐵礦同時打火。它不必像火繩槍那樣一路點著引線，所以能上馬、能夜戰，卻要極精細的金工，一柄造價遠高於長槍，因此只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛，荷蘭與西班牙的軍械帳冊上屬於少數被特別登記的兵器。同一套技術路線在十八世紀被燧發機件取代，到一八二五年的爪哇，它早已不是野戰裝備，只作為獵槍與舊式收藏留在歐洲；但它留下的原理正是荷軍主力兵物的來歷：一八二五年至一八三〇年，荷屬東印度軍隊裝備的是燧發滑膛步槍，配刺刀與定裝紙包彈，歐洲本土還在此役中增援三千餘人。炮兵方面是伴隨步兵行進的輕型野戰炮與攻城炮，炮車靠牛馬拖曳，攻城則靠壕溝、柴排與圍城炮。孟古內加蘭團等本地輔助軍所用的，也是荷方發給的燧發槍。起義軍的火力來源則雜亂得多：起義初期多數人只有爪哇傳統的竹矛、短刀與農具，火器靠繳獲的荷方燧發槍與少量火炮，也靠華商與英美私運商供應，並自行製造火藥與彈藥。爪哇村社本來就有預先修好的寨牆與圍柵，起義軍把它們改成據點，路上則以伐倒的樹木與削尖的竹籤築起路障。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol of 1500 on the card was the earliest handgun to carry a true lock work in the breech: the cock held a piece of pyrite, the trigger released a spring, a steel wheel spun and threw sparks into the priming pan, and a fragment of pyrite in the frizzen struck the fire at the same moment. It needed no slow match cord burning the whole way, so it could be used on horseback and in the dark, but it demanded very fine metalwork and cost far more than a long gun, which is why it was issued only to officers of the musket line and to guards, and it appears in the Dutch and Spanish ordnance registers as one of the few weapons entered by name. The same line of mechanism was displaced by the flintlock in the eighteenth century; by 1825 in Java the wheellock was long out of field service and survived only as a hunting piece and a curiosity in Europe. What the card does mark, though, is the parent of the main armament of the Dutch army: between 1825 and 1830 the Dutch East Indies army was armed with flintlock muskets with bayonets and paper cartridges, and the homeland sent more than three thousand reinforcements during the war. The artillery was light field pieces and siege guns that marched with the infantry, the gun carriages hauled by oxen and horses, while sieges were conducted with trenches, fagots and siege batteries. The native auxiliaries, the Mangkunegaran Legion among them, were likewise issued flintlock muskets by the Dutch. The rebels' sources of firepower were far more mixed: at the outset most men had only Javanese bamboo spears, krises and farm tools, their firearms being captured Dutch flintlock muskets and a few guns, topped up by Chinese merchants and by British and American smugglers, and they made their own gunpowder and ammunition. Javanese villages had always had pre-built enclosure walls and fences, which the rebels turned into strongpoints, and on the roads they raised blockades of felled trees and sharpened bamboo stakes.
tactics: 荷軍這五年的戰術可以用一句話概括：把游擊的地盤變成沒有游擊的地方。一八二五年七八月，援軍以晝夜行軍的方式趕到日惹解圍，再以三個月的圍城把起義軍逼退，隨後對塞拉隆方向的反攻因迪波內加羅轉移而落空。一八二六年秋冬，荷軍在梭羅以西的加沃克迎擊北上的起義軍，憑線列步槍、刺刀與炮兵的火力優勢打散對方兵力，迫使戰爭由會戰轉成游擊；此後荷軍改弦更張，先靠巡邏隊與小股搜索部隊把起義軍從村落裡趕出，再自一八二七年起大規模修築稜堡體系：沿主要道路與河流設卡，每座土築稜堡配以壕溝、木柵與火炮，兵員由各王國的常備隊與輔助兵輪替，目標是切斷起義軍的糧源與游擊縱深。到一八二八年至一八二九年，全島共建二百五十八座稜堡，其中一百三十三座集中在這兩年，位置多在日惹與巴格連一帶，起義軍被壓在普羅戈河與博戈旺托河之間的一小片地方。起義軍的戰術則完全針對這一體系：利用齊腰的草莽埋伏在道路兩側，以冷槍狙擊縱隊；騎兵藏身於以竹片編成的籬笆之中，接近後才衝出；沿途村人帶著鋤頭與扁擔加入戰鬥，專截退路；路障則由伐倒的樹木與削尖的竹籤組成。他們用繳獲的荷方火槍配自製火藥射擊，並以村落寨牆為堡壘。爪哇雨季與旱季的節奏也左右戰局，每年十一月至翌年四月多雨，行軍與攻堅都困難，雙方屢次在雨季停手；一八二九年一月至四月之間，雙方再停火三個月，荷軍趁此重整，六月才發動總攻。
tacticsEn: The Dutch tactics of these five years can be put in one sentence: turn the ground of the guerrilla into ground where guerrilla cannot live. In July and August 1825 a relief column marched day and night to lift the siege of Yogyakarta, and three months of blockade then forced the besiegers away; the subsequent Dutch attempt to storm Selarong failed because Diponegoro had already moved off. In the autumn and winter of 1826 the Dutch met the insurgents marching north at Gawok west of Surakarta, shattered their numbers with the fire of linear muskets, bayonets and artillery, and forced the war from pitched battle into a guerrilla campaign. The Dutch then changed their method: first patrols and small search parties drove the insurgents out of the villages, and from 1827 field fortifications were built on a large scale. Forts were sited along the main roads and rivers, each earthwork with ditch, palisade and guns, manned in turn by the standing troops and auxiliaries of the princely states, the object being to cut the rebels off from supplies and to deny them depth for the guerrilla. By 1828 and 1829 two hundred and fifty-eight forts stood across the island, a hundred and thirty-three of them raised in those two years, concentrated around Yogyakarta and the Bagelen area, and the insurgents were squeezed into a small tract between the Progo and the Bogowonto. The rebel tactics were aimed squarely at that system: they lay in the waist-high grass on both sides of the roads and sniped at the columns with cold shots; cavalry hid behind fences woven of bamboo and only charged once close; villagers came into the fight with hoe and carrying pole, and their business was to cut off the retreat; blockades were built of felled trees and sharpened bamboo stakes. They fired captured Dutch muskets with their own powder and used the enclosure walls of the villages as their redoubts. The rhythm of the wet and dry seasons shaped the fighting as well: from November to April the rains made marching and assaulting hard and both sides repeatedly stood off through the wet months, and between January and April 1829 there was a second ceasefire of three months, used by the Dutch to reorganise before the general offensive of June.
data: 留下數字的地方不少，但兩邊的戰報都往自己一方添水。荷方在開戰時歸德·科克指揮的兵力約一萬二千五百人，其中約半數是本地徵召兵；其後自荷蘭本土增援三千一百五十四名歐洲兵，戰爭期間又徵召一萬餘名本地輔助兵。一八二八年，爪哇與馬都拉的輔助兵略逾五千人，北蘇拉威西與哥倫打洛約一千三百人，布通七百人，馬魯古八百五十人，巴厘王國出一千名傭兵；同年荷方帳上登記的本地輔助兵約九千人，其中約二千五百人屬孟古內加蘭團。起義軍方面，迪波內加羅的編制是十六名指揮官各領兵千、封戶萬戶，貼身衛隊三百至四百騎兵，起義之初約有七十名王族帶著武裝侍從加入；北岸塞朗王公部初報八千人；北上的起義軍在加沃克仍佔數量優勢，敗後散兵約五千人，到一八二九年九月十七日西盧克村一戰後只剩三百人左右，一八三〇年三月二十八日在馬格朗被捕時隨身僅約五十人、護衛百餘人。時間線上，一八二五年七月二十一日宣布起義，七月二十八日圍困日惹，八月十九日荷軍援軍解圍，九月二十五日德·科克率七千五百人抵達日惹；一八二六年十月十五日加沃克之戰；一八二七年四月德·科克麾下已有一千六百人陣亡；一八二八年十一月凱亞·馬加投降；一八二九年十月森托特投降；一八三〇年三月二十八日迪波內加羅被捕，戰事至此結束。荷軍軍人死亡約一萬五千人，其中荷籍約八千、本地徵召兵約七千，多數死於熱帶病與野戰醫院衛生惡劣；自荷蘭本土出發的三千一百五十四人的遠征隊，到一八三〇年已有三分之二死於戰地。起義軍戰死估計在二萬以內。戰費約二千萬至二千五百萬荷蘭盾，而其後推行的栽培制度在廢除前為國庫帶來估計逾八億盾的收入。爪哇全島人口約六百萬。迪波內加羅一八三〇年流放萬雅老，一八三三年移往望加錫，一八四九年起被禁錮於鹿特丹堡，一八五五年一月八日死於望加錫。
dataEn: Figures survive in fair number, though the reports of both sides added water to their own side. At the outset the Dutch force under de Kock's command in the Indies numbered about twelve thousand five hundred men, roughly half of them native recruits; there followed three thousand one hundred and fifty-four European soldiers sent from the Netherlands, and more than ten thousand native auxiliaries were recruited during the war. In 1828 the auxiliaries from Java and Madura numbered slightly over five thousand, those from North Sulawesi and Gorontalo about one thousand three hundred, from Buton seven hundred, from the Moluccas eight hundred and fifty, with a thousand Balinese mercenaries; in the same year the Dutch rolls carried about nine thousand native auxiliaries, of whom some two thousand five hundred belonged to the Mangkunegaran Legion. On the rebel side, Diponegoro's organisation gave sixteen commanders a nominal thousand men and ten thousand households each, and his personal escort was three to four hundred cavalry; at the beginning about seventy members of the royal family joined him with their armed retinues, the force of Prince Serang on the north coast was reported at eight thousand, the insurgents marching north still held a numerical advantage at Gawok and some five thousand men remained in scattered groups after that defeat, only about three hundred were left after the battle at the village of Siluk on 17 September 1829, and when Diponegoro was arrested at Magelang on 28 March 1830 he had some fifty men with him and rather more than a hundred escorts. On the chronology: the rebellion was declared on 21 July 1825, Yogyakarta was invested on 28 July, the Dutch relief arrived on 19 August, and de Kock entered Yogyakarta with seven thousand five hundred men on 25 September; the battle of Gawok fell on 15 October 1826; by April 1827 sixteen hundred of de Kock's men had been killed; Kyai Maja surrendered in November 1828; Sentot surrendered in October 1829; and the arrest of Diponegoro on 28 March 1830 closed the war. Dutch military dead numbered about fifteen thousand, of whom roughly eight thousand were European and seven thousand native recruits, and most of them died of tropical disease aggravated by poor hygiene in the field hospitals; of the three thousand one hundred and fifty-four strong expeditionary force that sailed from the Netherlands, two thirds were dead in the field by 1830. Rebel battle deaths are put at twenty thousand or less. The war cost an estimated twenty to twenty-five million guilders, while the Cultivation System introduced afterwards brought the treasury an estimated income of more than eight hundred million guilders before its abolition. The population of Java was about six million. Diponegoro was exiled to Manado in 1830, moved to Makassar in 1833, was confined in Fort Rotterdam from 1849, and died at Makassar on 8 January 1855.
cause: 打起上來有遠因，也有近因。遠因是荷蘭在爪哇的權力結構本身：一七五五年《吉延提條約》把馬塔蘭蘇丹國切成日惹與梭羅兩塊王領地，一七五七年又分出孟古內加蘭；一七九九年荷屬東印度的公司政權崩解，一八〇六年總督達恩德爾斯推行集權，英軍一八一一年至一八一六年佔領爪哇，一八一二年的英軍攻破日惹王宮、廢黜哈孟庫布沃諾二世另立幼主，削弱王公勢力的同時也留下對荷蘭的深刻怨恨。荷蘭一八一六年恢復統治後，駐紮官制度、賠償要求、地租的廢除與新稅制的引入，逐步抽空王室的財政基礎，爪哇本地王公在英法時期反而坐大，一八二四年《倫敦條約》之後，殖民地當局更要趁勢削平諸王國。宗教層面的推力同樣真實：一八二一年霍亂流行、一八二二年默拉皮火山噴發，鄉間出現末世論的聖戰思潮，迪波內加羅自己也寫下關於爪哇將毀的預言，於是他不再只是被排斥的攝政，而成了號召者。近因極其具體：一八二五年六月十七日，駐官斯米薩特下令修一條穿過德加爾雷亞莊園附近的道路，與莊園衛士衝突數次；七月二十日荷軍前來逮捕他，他退入塞拉隆洞穴，二十一日宣布起義。
causeEn: There were remote causes and immediate ones. The remote cause was the structure of Dutch power in Java itself: the Treaty of Giyanti of 1755 cut the Mataram Sultanate into the two princely territories of Yogyakarta and Surakarta, and Mangkunegaran was split off in 1757; the corporate government of the Dutch East Indies collapsed in 1799, Governor-General Daendels imposed centralisation in 1806, and British troops occupied Java from 1811 to 1816, storming the keraton of Yogyakarta in 1812, deposing Hamengkubuwono II and setting a child in his place, which diminished the princes while leaving a deep grievance against the Dutch. After Dutch rule was restored in 1816, the residency system, the demand for indemnities, the abolition of the land rent and the introduction of a new tax system slowly drained the finances of the court, and the Javanese princes had in fact grown stronger during the French and British years; after the Treaty of London of 1824 the colonial government was more than ever set on levelling the principalities. The religious pressure was just as real: the cholera epidemic of 1821 and the eruption of Merapi in 1822 spread through the countryside a millenarian mood of holy war, and Diponegoro himself wrote down prophecies of the ruin of Java, so that he ceased to be merely an excluded regent and became a caller of men. The immediate cause was extremely concrete: on 17 June 1825 the resident Smissaert ordered a road built or repaired close to the Tegalreja estate, and it clashed repeatedly with the men of the estate; on 20 July Dutch troops came to arrest him, he withdrew into the cave at Selarong, and on 21 July he declared his rebellion.
impact: 這場戰爭把爪哇的權力地圖徹底改寫。三個王國失去了幾乎所有外圍領地與行政權，日惹蘇丹國的疆界被壓到今日日惹特別區的大小，梭羅蘇南國的蘇南帕庫布沃諾六世於一八三〇年被廢黜流放亞摩爾；帕庫阿蘭一世與孟古內加羅二世則因效忠荷方而保住席位，迪波內加羅的後裔在一九五〇年之前不得進入日惹王宮。爪哇此後百餘年再無大規模武裝反抗，直到第二次世界大戰與一九四五年的獨立革命。第二層影響在殖民戰術上：這場持久戰與游擊戰讓荷蘭明白，以小規模遠征軍逐村清剿只會被拖入消耗，於是此後在爪哇以外的殖民戰爭改用沿海轟擊與大規模登陸，力求以震懾摧毀抵抗意志；同時因兵源不足與對本地兵忠誠的懷疑，荷屬東印度軍開始招募非洲人，印尼人稱他們為黑荷蘭人。第三層是財政與制度的：戰費與隨後爆發的比利時革命令荷蘭國庫吃緊，約翰內斯·范登博斯自一八三〇年推行的栽培制度以強制勞役榨取莊園收成，其收入估計逾八億盾，成為荷蘭東印度財政的支柱，也把爪哇農村的負擔推向新的高度。政治文化上的影響更為長久：迪波內加羅在流放地寫成的《迪波內加羅傳》逾一千頁，爪哇皮影戲至今仍演此戰，二戰後的印尼民族主義把這場戰爭與他塑造為民族英雄，一九七三年他被正式定為印尼民族英雄。
impactEn: The war rewrote the political map of Java. The three principalities lost nearly all their outlying territories and administrative powers: the Yogyakarta Sultanate was reduced to roughly the extent of today's Special Region of Yogyakarta, and Sunan Pakubuwono VI of the Surakarta Sunanate was deposed and exiled to Ambon in 1830; Paku Alam I and Mangkunegara II kept their places for having stayed loyal to the Dutch, while Diponegoro's descendants were barred from the keraton of Yogyakarta until 1950. Java saw no large-scale armed resistance again for more than a century, until the Second World War and the Indonesian National Revolution of 1945. The second layer of the consequences lies in colonial warfare: this war of attrition and guerrilla taught the Dutch that clearing the country village by village with small expeditionary columns only led to a war of exhaustion, so in the colonial wars outside Java they turned to coastal bombardment and large-scale landings, seeking to break the will to resist by shock; and because of the shortage of manpower and their doubts about the loyalty of native troops, the Dutch East Indies army began recruiting Africans, whom the Indonesians called the Black Dutchmen. The third layer is financial and institutional: the cost of the war and the Belgian revolution that followed it strained the Dutch treasury, and the Cultivation System introduced by Johannes van den Bosch from 1830 squeezed the plantation output out of the peasantry through forced labour, bringing in an estimated more than eight hundred million guilders and becoming the pillar of the East Indies treasury, while pushing the burden on the Javanese countryside to a new height. The political and cultural legacy is the longest of all: the Babad Diponegoro, more than a thousand pages long, which Diponegoro wrote in exile, is still narrated in Javanese shadow puppet plays, and in the nationalism that followed the Second World War the war and the prince were turned into a national hero, officially designated as such in Indonesia in 1973.
result: 荷方在制度上取得了完勝，代價卻寫在帳上。一八二五年八、九月荷軍先解日惹之圍，一八二六年十月十五日在加沃克擊敗起義軍主力，戰爭由會戰轉為游擊；一八二七年起稜堡體系逐步收網，起義軍被壓到巴格連與普羅戈河上游的一小片地方；一八二八年十一月凱亞·馬加投降，一八二九年六月荷軍發動總攻，九月十七日西盧克村一役起義軍損失多名指揮官，十月森托特投降，此後各部首領陸續放下武器。國王威廉一世給范登博斯的指示是必須殺死或擒獲迪波內加羅、不許議和，但德·科克力主談判並為他爭取到安全的通行：一八三〇年三月二十八日迪波內加羅到馬格朗的荷蘭駐官宅邸拜訪德·科克時被當場拘捕，他的一百餘名護衛當時正在晨操，被和平解除武裝，他當日被押往三寶壟，隨即流放萬雅老，一八三三年移往望加錫，一八四九年起禁錮於鹿特丹堡，一八五五年一月八日死於望加錫。戰事至此結束，日惹蘇丹國在同年被迫簽署新約，割讓大片土地、賠付巨款並接受荷方駐軍，梭羅蘇南國在其後數年內也被套上類似的條款。回頭看卡面那件一五〇〇年的輪發手槍：它在此役中沒有上過戰場，戰場上真正開火的是燧發滑膛步槍；它在史上的位置，是把無需點火即可擊發這個念頭從火繩時代帶到後膛時代的先聲，日後荷軍與起義軍手上那些帶刺刀的燧發槍，機件原理正是它的直系後裔。
resultEn: On institutions the Dutch won outright, and the cost was written on the ledger. In August and September 1825 the Dutch first lifted the siege of Yogyakarta; on 15 October 1826 they broke the main body of the insurgents at Gawok, and the war became a guerrilla war; from 1827 the fort system closed in and the insurgents were squeezed into a small tract of the Bagelen and the upper Progo; Kyai Maja surrendered in November 1828, the Dutch general offensive opened in June 1829, the battle at the village of Siluk on 17 September cost the rebels a number of their commanders, Sentot surrendered in October, and the remaining leaders laid down their arms one after another. William I's instruction to van den Bosch was that Diponegoro was to be killed or captured and that no agreement was to be entered into, but de Kock argued for negotiation and won him a safe conduct: on 28 March 1830 Diponegoro called on de Kock at the Dutch resident's house at Magelang and was arrested on the spot; his escort of rather more than a hundred men was out on morning drill at the time and was peacefully disarmed, and he was taken the same day to Semarang and thence into exile at Manado, moved to Makassar in 1833, confined in Fort Rotterdam from 1849, and dead at Makassar on 8 January 1855. With that the war was over; in the same year the Sultanate of Yogyakarta was forced to sign a new convention, ceding large tracts of land, paying heavy indemnity and accepting a Dutch garrison, and the Surakarta Sunanate was made to accept similar terms within the following years. Turning back to the wheellock pistol of 1500 on the card: it never saw a battlefield in this war, for the weapon that actually fired here was the flintlock musket; its place in history is as the first hint of the idea that a gun may be triggered without any fire being carried, carrying the idea from the age of the matchlock into the age of the breech, and the flintlock muskets with bayonets that the Dutch and the rebels later carried were its direct descendants in the mechanism itself.
